description: An elevation (south/north/east/west: the façade seen from that side) or a section (section-ew: an east–west cut looking north; section-ns: a north–south cut looking east) of the whole building as SVG text: hidden-line drawing, cut walls/slabs/roofs solid, level lines with elevations. Drawing units are metres, y down. For a picture, use capture_view with mode "drawing".

flip.description: Sections: look the other way (south / west)

offset.description: Sections: where to cut, mm (north for section-ew, east for section-ns). Default: through the middle

name: get_drawing_svg
title: Get elevation or section (SVG)
